name: The Law of Nature
description: Yaman and Doğa’s paths cross once again, years after a disastrous first encounter during a job interview. As two strong-willed people from completely different worlds, their initial clash gradually turns into an inevitable connection as fate begins to reshape both of their lives.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Yaman, an idealistic engineer, suffers a crushing disappointment when he is humiliated by Doğa, the daughter of a powerful business owner, during the most important job interview of his life. Soon after, he becomes the victim of a tragic accident that turns his world upside down. Five years later, fate brings them face to face once again in a way neither of them could have imagined. Doğa, whose failed ventures have earned her a reputation for ruining every project she touches, is preparing to leave for Paris to pursue a new opportunity. Her father Hulusi decides to teach her some hard lessons about life and sends her to an organic farming estate in which he is an investor. What Doğa does not realize is that the farm is now managed by Yaman. In this world far removed from the glittering towers and corporate rules that Doğa is used to, her influence no longer holds power. Here, the rules belong to Yaman—a man shaped by hard work, perseverance, and a burning desire for revenge.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Yaman rescues Doğa and takes her to shore, but Mert implies that he was the one who saved her. The first meeting between Hulusi and Yaman is tense. The residents of the farm are worried about the possibility of Hulusi withdrawing his support. After the accident, Hulusi agrees to Doğa’s request and decides to send her to France. However, Doğa’s decision will surprise everyone, especially Yaman.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Doğa, in order to prove her equality with those on the farm, returns her car and credit cards to her father, while Yaman assigns her the heaviest tasks. Upon learning that her fierce rival Müge in Istanbul plans to throw a party in town to humiliate her, Doğa obtains a fake medical report in order to escape here. When Yaman discovers this deceit, he will force Doğa to work as a waiter at her mortal enemy's party in exchange for not reporting the report. Doğa is faced with the possibility of being humiliated in front of her mortal enemy.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Doğa's farm interview angers Yaman; he feels his efforts are being overshadowed and gives her one last chance. If she sells the strawberries in the depot by the next evening, she stays; if she fails, she leaves. Although the initial attempts yield no results, Doğa succeeds in gathering orders by turning the strawberries into cake with the support of social media. When she crosses to the other side for the final delivery, she encounters an unexpected danger. When Doğa doesn't return, Yaman sets out to search for her, and the rivalry between them turns into a critical test where hidden feelings come to light.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: After Yaman hands over the farm's management to Doğa, the sabotage of the water pump leads to a major crisis. While Doğa passes her first leadership test, she barely manages to stop Yaman, who holds Mert responsible for the sabotage. Hopes for a solution are pinned on Deli Nazmi, who controls the water source. However, when Nazmi mistakes Doğa for his daughter Kezban, whom he lost years ago, Doğa and Yaman find themselves caught in a fake marriage scheme. Meanwhile, as Perihan and Hulusi grow closer, the gossip Nesrin learns ignites the spark for events that will alter the farm's future. Following all these developments, Doğa uncovers a trace of a major secret from the past.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Upon learning the reason for Yaman's anger toward her, Doğa decides to empathize with him instead of clashing. The farm management being in her hands for three days gives Doğa the opportunity to both ease the tension between her and Yaman and implement her own ideas at the farm. However, the beach development plan creates new tension between the town's values and modern business principles. While Mert continues his plans regarding the farm land, Nesrin also moves to sell the shares belonging to Saffet. The growing closeness between Burak and Vera draws attention, while Hulusi and Perihan's unfinished love story resurfaces. As everyone at Keçilik Farm pursues their own agenda, the secret Yaman will share with Müge, Doğa's sworn enemy, will once again shift the balances.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Shocked by the revelation of his hidden past, Yaman returns to the farm on the condition of maintaining a professional and distant relationship with Doğa. Meanwhile, two new customers named Muzaffer and Semra arrive at the farm, convinced by Doğa, but they have a secret plan. The duo has infiltrated the farm with the intent of seeking revenge against Hulusi Arcalı, claiming that he seized their father's inheritance. As the rekindled love between Perihan and Hulusi after years draws attention, the gang knocks Doğa out and kidnaps her. Realizing the situation, Yaman sets out to sea by boat and stages a raid on the yacht. Just as the ransom message reaches Hulusi, Yaman and Doğa find themselves face-to-face with a great danger threatening their lives on the yacht.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The hostage situation of Doğa and Yaman opens the door to an old reckoning from Hulusi's past, while the duo finds themselves in the midst of an ever-growing danger. Yaman's fall into the sea while trying to protect Doğa, and Doğa jumping in after him without a second thought, takes their relationship to an entirely different place. Upon returning to the farm, as Yaman assigns Doğa new responsibilities, the resentments within the family grow ever larger. Nesrin's secret deal with Mert to convince Saffet to sell his shares puts the farm's future at risk. Upon learning of the situation, Yaman springs into action to prevent the sale. However, a huge surprise awaits him that he never expected.
